buttons.label: Fit
buttons.description: Fit the Gaussians to the gated points shown on the map.

buttons.label: Select
buttons.description: Turn the selected Gaussian (or the only one) into an elliptical gate at Selection σ.

sections.label: Selection σ:
sections.description: Number of sigmas used for Gaussian burst selection (1.0 = 1σ).

buttons.label: Settings
buttons.description: Configure the EM and save it to your user settings.

buttons.label: add
buttons.description: Add a Gaussian in the middle of the map.

buttons.label: del
buttons.description: Remove the selected Gaussian (or the last).

columns.title: Name
columns.tooltip: Component parameter: centre x, y, widths σx, σy, correlation ρ and weight w.

columns.title: Fixed
columns.tooltip: Hold this parameter in the fit.

columns.title: Link
columns.tooltip: Follow another parameter: type its name (x_2, sd_x_1, or 'Group: name' of another table); clear to unlink.

sections.label: Select point
sections.description: Clicks on the map add a Gaussian there.

sections.label: Marginals
sections.description: Draw each Gaussian on the x and y marginals.

sections.label: Log Gauss
sections.description: Fit and draw the Gaussians in log scale on both axes (positive values only); off fits in the axes' own scale.

buttons.label: Save
buttons.description: Save the Gaussians with the histogram and model (.json and .csv files).

buttons.label: Load
buttons.description: Load Gaussians from a .json or .csv file.
